name: On Deaf Ears

steps.t: Find the researcher's guest logs on the reception computers
steps.go: Head to the Lobby front desk on the main floor, beside the Security room. Use the highlighted computer in the row to send the logs.

steps.t: Find where the researcher held their lecture, and access their notes
steps.go: Go to the Auditorium south-east of the Lobby, reached through the Security building and the Business Centre. Use the computer on the lecturer's desk.

steps.t: Find information about the prototypes on the Medical Research computers
steps.pin: On Deaf Ears - Send Data in Medical
steps.go: Go to the main Medical Research lab on the second floor. The computer sits by one of the lab doors, towards the north-east corner.

steps.t: Find the printed shipping logs in the Assembly Workshops
steps.go: In eastern Assembly Workshops, climb the metal stairs by the Raider Hatch to the office. Search the cardboard box there.

notes: Three sources agree on the four steps. Alternate pins share steps: 'On Deaf Ears - Reception computer' (step 1) and 'Send Data in Medical' (step 3). Wiki says the shipping logs point to Acerra Spaceport, but no source lists a follow-up objective in this quest. Hand-in is to Lance in Speranza.

name: Snap And Salvage

steps.t: Take a Photo of any of the Rovers in the Sandbox
steps.pin: Take a Photo of any of the Rovers in the Sandbox
steps.go: Drop to the lower layer and go to the Sandbox near the centre of the map. Interact with either rover buggy to photograph it.

steps.t: Search the papers in the Security Checkpoint room by the Lobby
steps.pin: Search the papers in the Security Checkpoint room by the Lobby
steps.go: Enter the restricted Security door on the east side of the Lobby. On the ground floor, search the papers on the three-sided desk in the small office.

steps.t: Deliver a Flow Controller to Tian Wen
steps.go: Loot desks and drawers, for example the side rooms of the Security Checkpoint, until one drops. Then hand it to Tian Wen in Speranza.

steps.t: Deliver a Magnetron to Tian Wen
steps.go: Check storage in rooms off the corridor between the Atrium and Lobby; spawns are random. Hand it to Tian Wen in Speranza.

notes: Wiki lists the two deliveries as separate steps; PC Gamer combines them. Alternate pins: 'Papers in Security Checkpoint room' (step 2); 'Possible FLOW CONTROLLER', 'FLOW CONTROLLER', 'Flow Controller' (step 3, named inconsistently by MetaForge); 'Possible Magnetron Location' (step 4). Item spawns are not guaranteed.

name: Cold Storage

steps.t: Search any J Kozma Ventures container
steps.pin: Search any J Kozma Ventures container
steps.go: Find a container stamped J Kozma Ventures, for example in the Lobby Metro on the lower layer opposite the exfil call button. Search it for the books.

steps.t: Deliver the Old World Books to Shani
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the books and hand them to Shani.

notes: All agree on the container search, which must be done in one round. The delivery wording differs: wiki says 'Deliver the Old World Books to Shani', PC Gamer quotes 'Deliver the Rare Books to Shani'; gamemaps lists only the search. Container spots also differ (wiki: loading bay, reached by dropping from the 2nd floor; PC Gamer: Lobby Metro). Alternate pin 'Search Any J Kozma Ventures container' (capitalised differently). The MetaForge pin 'Cold Storage' is not tied to any objective by the guides, so it is left unassigned.

name: In My Image

steps.t: Deploy into Stella Montis
steps.go: Start a raid on Stella Montis.

steps.t: Find and search 3 Androids
steps.go: Search three android bodies; Medical Research has the most, with more in the Lobby, Atrium and Assembly. Try the other layer if one floor is empty.

notes: Wiki and gamemaps give identical objectives. The 'Robotics Sandbox' pin is not named by the guides as an objective; likely an android area, left unassigned.

name: With A View

steps.t: Obtain a Rotary Encoder
steps.go: Loot drawers in Assembly; it is Exodus loot found on this map. Keep it safe for the next step.

steps.t: Visit any of the Control Rooms near the Assembly Line
steps.go: Go to one of the control rooms beside the Assembly Line, east or west side.

steps.t: Use the Rotary Encoder to activate the server switch
steps.go: In the control room, use the Encoder on the server switch: the lever in the east or the yellow-lit console in the west.

steps.t: Interact with a nearby computer to help identify the correct paths
steps.go: A nearby computer becomes usable; hold interact for a few seconds.

steps.t: Deliver an Ion Sputter to Shani
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Find an Ion Sputter, ideally in your safe pocket, and give it to Shani.

notes: Wiki and gamemaps give the same five objectives. Shacknews supplies the switch locations (east lever, west yellow console) but merges steps. No MetaForge pins for the control room, switch or computer.

name: Movie Night

steps.t: Deliver a Portable TV to Apollo
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Find a Portable TV in residential drawers or filing cabinets on any map, for example Buried City, and give it to Apollo.

steps.t: On Stella Montis, search the Cultural Archives for old movie tapes
steps.go: Enter the Cultural Archives from the Atrium, go down the stairs and turn right. Search the sheet-covered furniture in the south-west corner.

steps.t: Deliver the Stack Of Movie Tapes to Apollo
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the tapes and give them to Apollo.

notes: Wiki and gamemaps agree on objective order (TV first). PC Gamer walks through the tapes first and hands both in together, which is guide order, not a different objective set. Wiki marks the TV step as 'in one round'.

name: Stable Housing

steps.t: Go to the Security Bridge
steps.go: Head to the Security Bridge building by the Lobby in the north of the map.

steps.t: Search for the safe in the side room by the third-floor staircases
steps.go: Climb to the third floor and enter the room opposite the stairwell. The safe is on the desk in the back right corner.

steps.t: Head upstairs to the fourth-floor control room
steps.go: Go up one more floor to the control room opposite the stairs.

steps.t: Use the Access Card Printer to print a key to the safe
steps.go: Use the terminal on your right in the fourth-floor control room. The card will not work, which is expected.

steps.t: Search for alternate ways into the safe
steps.go: Back on the third floor, check the note board right of the safe-room door, behind a terminal, for the safe code.

steps.t: Retrieve the contents of the safe
steps.go: Enter the code at the safe and take the Project Heartwood Blueprints.

steps.t: Deliver the Project Heartwood Blueprints to Tian Wen
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract via the subway stairs just north of the Security Bridge, then give Tian Wen the blueprints.

notes: Wiki and gamemaps give identical seven objectives; PC Gamer matches. Must be done in one round. Alternate pin 'Go to Security Bridge' (step 1). No dedicated pin for the fourth-floor control room, so the printer pin in that room is reused.

name: Fragmented Logs

steps.t: In either of the Robotic Sandbox control rooms, repair the out-of-service terminal with 1 Electrical Component
steps.go: Bring an Electrical Component to a Robotic Sandbox control room, such as the one between Sandbox A and B. Fix the terminal overlooking Sandbox B.

steps.t: Enable the power in any of the conduit backrooms near the Robotic Sandboxes
steps.go: Go to a conduit backroom near the Sandboxes, for example Control Room B2 down the ramp south of Sandbox B. Pull the main power switch between the servers.

steps.t: Boot the main frame data terminal in the Cultural Archives service backrooms
steps.pin: Boot the Main frame data Terminal
steps.go: Head to the Cultural Archives service backroom in the far east. Use the computer desk next to the server boxes.

notes: All three agree. PC Gamer says the steps can be done in any order. Alternate pin for step 1: 'Repair the out-of-service terminal with 1 Electrical Component' (the other control room).

name: Furtive Meetings

steps.t: Search for a secret meeting spot under a staircase in the Medical Research Area
steps.go: In the south-west corner of Medical Research, check under the stairs to the second floor. Look for white spray paint.

steps.t: Find the secret meeting spot near the ventilation shaft between Robotic Sandbox B and Seed Vault
steps.go: On the east side of Robotic Sandbox B, near the hallway to the Seed Vault, find the vent corner with paintings and graffiti.

steps.t: Find the secret meeting spot at the bottom of the staircase connecting Cultural Archives and Seed Vault
steps.pin: Cultural Archives and Seed Vault Meeting Spot
steps.go: Go to the foot of the stairs linking the Atrium, Cultural Archives and Seed Vault, by the pile of boxes.

steps.t: Search the meeting area
steps.go: Search the container beside the boxes at that last spot to get the Secret Meeting Info.

steps.t: Bring the Secret Meeting Info to Shani
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the item and give it to Shani.

notes: Wiki and gamemaps give identical objectives; all in one round. PC Gamer says the first two spots are photographed, while the trackers say search/find; the locations agree.

name: Last Entry

steps.t: Find and access the right work station in the Seed Vault for clues
steps.go: Go to the Seed Vault in the south-east. Climb the short metal stairs east of the vault door; the desk is on your left.

steps.t: Search for the hidden key in the adjacent room
steps.go: Enter the room a few steps up the hallway on the left. Search the rack of orange jumpsuits for the Seed Vault Box Key.

steps.t: Search the Seed Vault and unlock the seed deposit box
steps.go: Put a battery in the socket by the vault door to open it, clear any ARC, then use the key on the seed box terminal in the far vaults.

steps.t: Search the seed deposit box
steps.go: Interact with the opened box to collect the Official Shutdown Documentation.

steps.t: Bring the Official Shutdown Documentation to Shani
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract down the corridor to the west, then give it to Shani.

notes: All agree; one round. Wiki paraphrases step 3 as 'Return to the Seed Vault'; gamemaps wording used. Batteries spawn in the key room (by the clothes rack and the electrical box) per PC Gamer. Some sites call the quest 'Last Events'.

name: Someone Else's Shoes

steps.t: Scan any Android on Stella Montis
steps.pin: Scan any Android on Stella Montis
steps.go: Find a live android, one with flickering blue eyes, and scan it. Dead ones will not count, and spots vary.

steps.t: Find the Android in Research Lab 3 in the Medical Bay
steps.pin: Find the Android in Research Lab 3
steps.go: Go to Research Lab 3 in the Medical Bay and get close to the android strapped to the bed to scan it.

steps.t: Reach the Control Room in the Western Tunnels and search for clues
steps.pin: 3. Reach the Control Room in the Western Tunnels and search for clues
steps.go: Head to the Control Room in the Western Tunnels. Interact with the right console among the loot consoles.

notes: Both sources agree on three steps. Trader Celeste comes from the wiki only; Destructoid does not name one. No delivery or later step found.
